_about: Greenlands mixed-forest look profile, read from docs/Game-Design/concept-art/Greenlands-Forest-Look-v1.webp. Each role is a kind of asset the PCG graphs place and the asset-gap report checks. 'have' lists project meshes that fill the role today (paths under /Game/Frontier/Environment/Greenlands unless noted). Licensed Fab assets are read-only and are not counted toward a role here. Counts and shares are proposed targets, not tuning. Placement rules use terrain slope (degrees), height above local valley floor and road/river distance.

terrain.character: Rolling, rocky upland: soil hollows with grass, drier rises with exposed bedrock, rounded granite domes and ridges in the distance.
rules: Slope above 30 degrees exposes bedrock (rock material plus slab outcrops); below 15 degrees holds soil and grass.
Rises and ridge lines carry pines; hollows and stream sides carry young broadleaf.
Paths and dry ground show stone and needle/leaf litter, not grass.
Moss grows on the upward faces of boulders and slabs, never on their undersides.

buildings._about: Biome building library for the missing-asset report, keyed by settlement building name (definition section 8 or layout type). 'have': delivered meshes in the settlement's design, one main mesh per variant; a building needs as many variants as it has owner-supplied concept images (at least one). 'stand_ins': older project meshes that fill the slot in the graybox until then; they never close a row. Licensed Fab or Megascans meshes don't count.

layers.desc: Scots-pine-like: straight 20-30 m trunk, grey lower bark turning orange-brown above, high flat crown
Birch/alder-like young broadleaf, 6-10 m, light green, slender trunks
Mature oak for open meadow edges and harvest
1-3 m saplings in clearings and at forest edges; doubles as GAT-01 tree growth stage
Light-green tussock grass with seed heads
Low broad-leaf herb patches (lily-of-the-valley-like) under trees; future Herbalism look-alike
Sparse small white/yellow flowers in grass
Flat moss mats on ground and rock tops
Granite boulders 1.5-4 m, rounded, moss on top faces
Flat, fractured granite slabs emerging from soil, 3-8 m
Cobbles and pebbles 5-30 cm, grey-blue granite
Fallen pine needles and brown leaves, as decals or small meshes
Rocky soil with litter, blended by slope with grass and rock materials
Weathered granite with lichen, for steep terrain
Rounded rocky hill/dome silhouettes for distance; northern mountains belong to TER-01 backdrop

_place: Machine placement per role, read by dress_zone.py: per_ha target density, spacing minimum metres between instances of the role (0 = none), slope degrees and valley (metres above the local floor within 120 m) ranges, light 'sun' (more than 6 m from canopy), 'shade' (within 6 m) or 'any', clear metres from roads, water and buildings, scale range, sink as a fraction of mesh height, cluster instances per site, fallback role whose meshes stand in while this role has none (reported as a gap), harvest marks gameplay candidates. Roles without 'place' are not placed.
